reuse.why: Extends the existing shared applyWeekendRule/getDateWithSkippedWeekend pair that every schedule date path (getNextDate, upcoming dates, template) already uses, and threads the field through the existing parseRecurDate.

duplication.why: The non-working-day test is defined once in isNonWorkingDay and used both for the trigger and the stepping loop; no call site gains its own holiday logic.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, the RecurConfig type gains the field and rule-utils passes it into the recurrence, matching the existing layering.

scope.why: Only the weekend rule, the config type, the recurrence parser and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Holidays become part of the single weekend definition with an optional parameter, so every caller picks them up without changes.

one_place.where: applyWeekendRule / getDateWithSkippedWeekend / isNonWorkingDay in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by getNextDate, server/schedules/app.ts and server/budget/schedule-template.ts
